meaning: explanatory: it's that ~ / the thing is ~
notes: prototype-ids.tsv files this at N3, but every checked source lists it at N5. jlptsensei lists んです and のです as two entries; merged. Sentence-final の in questions is a separate entry (no-question); the matcher must tell explanatory の from possessive and nominalizer の.

meaning: ongoing action, resulting state, or habit
notes: Bunpro splits it into three points (progressive, state, habitual); merged here. jlptsensei and marumori list 〜ていた (past continuous) separately at N4; kept as a variant here, decide later whether it needs its own entry.

Classified as construction because all sources treat it as a clause-linking reason. Same surface as kara-from (particle); the matcher must check that から follows a predicate, not a noun. Sentence-initial だから is a conjunction word, not in any N5 list.

jlptsensei and bunpro list けど and けれども as two points; merged as spelling variants. marumori lists けど at N5 but けれども at N4. Clause-linking, so construction. Also softens a sentence-final clause (言ったけど…).
jlptsensei folds it into the が entry with the subject marker; split here because it links clauses. marumori lists （です・だ）が at N4. Must not be confused with ga-subject: this が follows a predicate.

jlptsensei and bunpro list でしょう and だろう separately; merged as polite/plain pair. Bunpro lists のだろうか at N4 and marumori lists (の)でしょうか at N4 as 'I wonder'; that wondering use may need its own entry at N4.
Third-person 〜たがる is N4 (prototype tagaru).
Noun + をください is a separate entry (o-kudasai). Negative ないでください is naide-kudasai.
Bunpro also lists がある + Noun (a noun that has ~) at N5; folded in here. Overlaps with ta-koto-ga-aru, which ends in the same verb.
The same verb いる is the auxiliary in te-iru; the matcher must not count 〜ている as existence.

meaning: because ~ / since ~ (softer, more objective than から)
notes: prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4, but all five checked sources list it at N5. Clause-linking, so construction. Casual んで collides with explanatory ん + て; flag for the matcher.
〜ましょうか (offer or suggestion as a question) is a separate entry, mashou-ka. A matcher for mashou must not also fire on ましょうか, or the two entries must be kept apart explicitly.

meaning: it's okay to do ~ / may I do ~?
notes: marumori bundles it with concessive 〜ても (even if); jlptsensei and bunpro put bare 〜ても at N4, so concessive ても is left out of this file. てもかまわない is N3 in bunpro; listed as a variant only for recognition, may move. Negative なくてもいい is nakute-mo-ii.
Spatial 'in front of' (Nの前) is covered by no-position. Time span + 前 (三年前, 'ago') is a word use, not this pattern; tanos's gloss mentions 'ago'.
Non-past 〜ることがある ('there are times when') is N4 in jlptsensei and marumori; the matcher must require the past た before こと.

meaning: without doing ~ / do B instead of A
notes: Level disagreement: bunpro places ないで (without doing) at N4. Overlaps with naide-kudasai and with sentence-final casual ないで ('don't'), which is a variant of naide-kudasai.

Level disagreement: two of three sources that list it say N4. Kept here only because prototype-ids.tsv files it at N5, so the N4 pass may skip it; reconcile with the N4 file. Standalone あとで ('later') is a word use.
prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4, but all five checked sources list it at N5.

form: 〜たほうがいい / 〜ないほうがいい
meaning: had better do ~ / had better not do ~
notes: prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4, but all five checked sources list it at N5. Bunpro and jt4y list the た and ない forms as two points; merged as the prototype does. Comparison ほうが in yori-hou-ga shares the noun ほう.
jlptsensei and jt4y list the verb なる; marumori lists なる and 〜になる at N5 but 〜くなる separately at N4. Must not fire inside ようになる or ことになる (prototype N3 entries).

meaning: won't you ~? / would you like to ~? (invitation)
notes: A plain negative question (行かない？) can be an invitation too, but it is hard to tell from a real negative question; low-confidence variant.
prototype-ids.tsv files this at N3, but all five checked sources list it at N5. marumori lists つもりで and つもりだった at N3; those uses can stay under this id or split later.
jlptsensei and marumori list ちゃいけない・じゃいけない as their own N5 point; merged as a contraction. 〜てはならない is listed by marumori at N2, so it is not a variant here.
prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4, but the four sources that list it say N5. The verb 過ぎる on its own ('to pass') is not the pattern.

meaning: shall I ~? / shall we ~? (offer or suggestion)
notes: Contains mashou; decide whether a sentence with ましょうか counts as both. Plain ようか depends on the volitional form, which is N4 in jlptsensei and bunpro.
Sentence-final casual ないで ('don't') is listed by marumori at N5 and by bunpro at N4; folded in as a variant. It looks like naide (without doing); the matcher tells them apart by what follows.

prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4, but the four sources that list it say N5 (tanos as なくちゃいけない). 〜なければいけない/ならない are N4 in jlptsensei, bunpro and marumori (prototype nakereba-naranai). 〜ないといけない is N5 in jlptsensei but N4 in bunpro and marumori, so it is left out.

meaning: gotta do ~ (casual, rest of 'must' left unsaid)
notes: Conflict with prototype-ids.tsv: nakereba-naranai (N4) lists なきゃ as its variant. Sources treat the cut-off なくちゃ・なきゃ as its own N5 point. Decide whether なきゃ belongs here or under nakereba-naranai; なくちゃいけない is a variant of nakute-wa-ikenai.
prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4, but the four sources that list it say N5. A single 〜たり is also common and should match.
The stem before に is a verb stem or an action noun (買い物に行く). Destination に + 行く (学校に行く) is not this pattern; that is ni or e-direction.
Indirect questions (何をするか分からない) are N4 in marumori; the matcher must not take question word + か at clause end as this.
marumori lists 何も〜ない again at N2 as an expression. いつも is listed as a word (itsumo); it is lexicalized and should not double count.
marumori pairs it with まだ〜ている (still doing) and もう〜ている (already); those are kept as variants and as uses of te-iru plus the words mada and mou.
jlptsensei lists は〜より and より〜ほうが as two N5 points; merged. Bare より 'than' is the particle entry yori. AとBとどちらが is N4 in bunpro.

meaning: out of ~, X is the most ~
notes: jlptsensei and bunpro list の中で ('among') alone at N4. The word 一番 alone is ichiban.
jlptsensei and bunpro also list にする/くする 'to make something ~' at N4; that change-of-state use is a different meaning with the same surface. Must not fire inside ことにする or ようにする.

meaning: a clause describing a noun (the book I read)
notes: Bunpro also lists が・の subject swap inside the clause at N5; folded in. Very frequent but hard to match from short units; the matcher may need to rely on a verb directly followed by a noun.
marumori merges 好き and 嫌い; the words alone are suki-kirai.
prototype-ids.tsv files this at N4; jlptsensei and marumori say N5, bunpro N4. marumori bundles concessive なくても ('even if not'), which is left to N4.
Tie between marumori (N5) and bunpro (N4); kept by the tie rule. It is the bare て-form at sentence end, so the matcher must tell it from te-form joining clauses.
Tie between marumori (N5) and bunpro (N4, also Number + しか〜ない); kept by the tie rule. jlptsensei lists it at neither N5 nor N4. しかない ('no choice but') is N3 in bunpro and marumori.

form: Nの前 / 後ろ / 横 / 中 / 上 / 下
meaning: in front of / behind / beside / in / on / under N
notes: Only marumori lists these as grammar; marumori puts 隣・横 again at N4. Nの前に (place) shares the surface of mae-ni (time); the meaning depends on the noun.
marumori lists 〜上手 (noun + が上手) rather than のが上手; folded in. 得意 is in tokui-nigate.
marumori lists 〜下手 (noun + が下手); folded in. 苦手 is in tokui-nigate.
Could be merged into nakute-wa-ikenai (same meaning, different final verb); kept apart because marumori puts it at N4 and the prototype keeps nakereba-naranai separate.
Only jlptsensei lists it. 〜たらどう ('why don't you') is N4 in jlptsensei, bunpro and marumori.
Tie between jlptsensei (N5) and marumori (〜ください, N4); kept by the tie rule. Differs from te-kudasai by what precedes ください (a noun, not a て-form).
Only marumori lists it. Near-synonym of ni-suru. ことに決める is not covered here.

marumori lists ます, ません, ました, ませんでした as four points; merged as one polite paradigm. Must not fire on the ませ inside ませんか or the まし inside ましょう when those entries match, unless double counting is intended.
Bunpro splits る-verbs and う-verbs; merged. Voiced だ after verbs collides with the copula だ; UniDic tags them differently (助動詞 タ vs ダ).

Bunpro lists て (conjunction), て (sequence) and て + B as separate N5 points; merged. て for reason or means is N4 in jlptsensei, bunpro and marumori. The て inside every て-construction (ている, てください...) also matches this; decide whether to report it only when nothing longer matched.
Bunpro splits る-verbs and う-verbs; merged. The adjective ない (no, there isn't) and i-adjective くない are different; UniDic tags 助動詞 ナイ vs 形容詞.
Bunpro lists dictionary form for each verb class plus 'Verbs (Non-past)'; merged. Probably too broad to report as a pattern; kept because sources list it.

marumori lists six forms (casual, formal, polite, past); bunpro lists じゃない and じゃなかった. Merged as one paradigm; split the past if matchers need it. Also covers な-adjective negative. Tag-question じゃない？ ('isn't it?') is N4 in jlptsensei, bunpro and marumori.
Also covers な-adjective past (静かだった); marumori lists that separately.
Includes よかった from いい. Must not fire on なかった (verb negative past) or くなかった.
Includes よくない from いい.
Bunpro lists 'Adjective + て・Noun + で' and 'Adjective + て + B'; merged. Noun + で collides with particles de-location and de-means; UniDic tags the copula で as 助動詞.
Bunpro splits verb classes; merged.
Tie between marumori (N5) and bunpro (N4, two points: sequence and reason); kept by the tie rule. Starts nakute-mo-ii, nakute-wa-ikenai and nakute-wa-naranai; the matcher must prefer those.

meaning: conjugation of the irregular verbs する and 来る
notes: marumori also lists 行く for its irregular て/た form (行って); folded in. Probably not a pattern to show learners; kept because sources list it.
Bunpro also lists の with the noun left out (私のです) at N5; folded in here. Distinct from no-nominalizer, no-pronoun, no-question and explanatory no-da.
Contrastive は (は〜が…は) is N4 in jlptsensei and marumori.

meaning: at / in / on (time, place of existence), to (target)
notes: marumori splits it into location/target, time, purpose and indirect object (giving), all N5; merged. Destination に is in e-direction; purpose に is in ni-iku. Bunpro lists frequency に (一日に三回) at N4.
marumori lists を for the path of motion (公園を歩く) at N4; folded in here unless it needs its own entry.
Clause-linking 'but' が is ga-but. が also appears inside ga-aru, ga-iru, no-ga-suki and others.
jlptsensei and tanos treat で as one point; bunpro, marumori and jt4y split place from means. Same surface as de-means and as the copula で (kute); tell them apart by the noun and the verb.

meaning: by / with / in (tool, method, language, total)
notes: marumori also lists で for total amount or time (全部で, 三人で) at N5; folded in. Material で (木でできている) is N4 in bunpro and marumori.
Bunpro lists 'and' and 'with' as two N5 points; merged. Quotation と is to-quote; conditional と is N4 (prototype to-conditional).
Emphatic 'as many as' も (Number + も) is N4 in jlptsensei, bunpro and marumori. Question word + も is interrogative-mo.
かな and かしら ('I wonder') are N4 in jlptsensei and marumori. か also ends masen-ka and mashou-ka.
marumori lists よね as its own N5 point; folded in here as a variant. It could instead count as both yo and ne.
よね is a variant of ne.

Bunpro and marumori list と and って as N5 points. jlptsensei lists と思う, という and って ('called') at N4, and marumori lists と思う at N4; those may get their own N4 entries (prototype to-iu is N4). marumori's って also covers casual topic って.

meaning: turns a clause into a noun (doing ~)
notes: Bunpro lists のは・のが at N5. The nominalizer こと is N4 in jlptsensei and bunpro (N5 only in marumori), so こと is left out. Appears inside no-ga-suki, no-ga-jouzu and no-ga-heta.

meaning: from (starting point in time or place)
notes: Same surface as kara-because; follows a noun here. Must not fire inside te-kara.
Bunpro lists Noun + まで and Verb + まで as two N5 points; merged. までに ('by') and まで 'even' are N4 in jlptsensei, bunpro and marumori.
jlptsensei, jt4y and tanos list に/へ together; bunpro lists へ and へいく. Destination に overlaps with the general ni entry; the matcher needs a motion verb to call it direction.
だけで ('just by') is N4 in jlptsensei and bunpro; listed as a variant only for recognition. marumori's ただ〜(だけ) folded in.

meaning: and (non-exhaustive list: A, B and so on)
notes: など is N5 in marumori but N4 in jlptsensei and bunpro, so など alone is left out.
jlptsensei lists は〜より at N5 and bare より at N4; bunpro lists より at N4; marumori lists より ('from' and 'more than') at N5. Overlaps with yori-hou-ga.
Same surface as ka-question; here か sits between nouns or clauses. 〜かどうか is N4 (prototype ka-douka).
Tie between bunpro (N5) and marumori (の・なの sentence ender, N4); kept by the tie rule. Close to no-da; may merge into it.
Extent くらい ('to the point that') is N3 in bunpro and marumori.

meaning: sentence ender for feeling or wish (how ~!, I wish ~)
notes: Tie between jlptsensei (N5) and marumori (N4); kept by the tie rule. Short な after a plain form collides with na-prohibitive (行くな = don't go); context decides.
Tie (2 N5, 2 N4); kept by the tie rule. Pairs with the N4 imperative (prototype meirei). Collides with naa written as な.

meaning: the ~ one (の stands in for a noun)
notes: Only bunpro lists it as its own point. Surface overlaps with no-nominalizer; here の follows an adjective and means 'one'.

Kind is a judgment call: the copula is an auxiliary, not a conjugation of another word, so filed as word. Bunpro also lists い-adjective + です and な-adjective + だ predicate use; folded in. Past and negative are datta-deshita and ja-nai.

form: この / その / あの / どの
meaning: this / that / that over there / which (+ noun)
notes: Sources list each word separately; grouped as one こそあど set. Split if matchers report single words. その also works as a filler; no source lists that.

form: これ / それ / あれ / どれ
meaning: this / that / that over there / which (one)
notes: Sources list each word separately; grouped as one こそあど set.
marumori lists もう〜ている at N5; folded in. もう少し ('a little more') is the same word.

meaning: adjectives ending in い (and their basic use)
notes: A word class, matched by POS tag. Bunpro lists い-adjective + noun at N5; folded in. Conjugations are katta, kunai, kunakatta, kute.

meaning: adjectives that take な before a noun
notes: A word class. Bunpro lists な-adjective + noun at N5; folded in. Predicate, past and negative go through the copula entries.
Only bunpro lists it as grammar, for its irregular conjugation (よ- stem). Appears inside te-mo-ii and hou-ga-ii.
まだ〜ていない is mada-te-inai.

form: ここ / そこ / あそこ / どこ
notes: Sources list each word separately; grouped as one こそあど set. こちら/そちら are not in any checked N5 list.

meaning: name suffixes (Mr./Ms., cute, for boys, formal)
notes: Only marumori lists them, as four points; grouped. Split if matchers report single suffixes.

meaning: but / however (at the start of a sentence)
notes: Conjunction. Same surface as N4 でも ('or something', 'even') in jlptsensei, bunpro and marumori, and as て-form + も (読んでも). Only the sentence-initial use is N5.
Conjunction.

meaning: and then / after that / since then
notes: Conjunction. Do not also count kara-from inside it.
Question word. 誰か/誰も are interrogative-ka and interrogative-mo.
The plain giving verb. marumori bundles it with 〜てあげる at N5, but jlptsensei and bunpro put 〜てあげる at N4 (prototype te-ageru), so the て-form use is left to N4.
The plain receiving verb. 〜てもらう is N4 in jlptsensei and bunpro (prototype te-morau).

meaning: to give (to me or my group)
notes: The plain giving verb toward the speaker. 〜てくれる is N4 in jlptsensei and bunpro (prototype te-kureru).
marumori lists 好きな～・嫌いな～ and ～好き・～嫌い as two points; bunpro lists すき and きらい. Grouped. Verb + のが好き is no-ga-suki.
Adverb. とても〜ない ('cannot possibly') is N3 in bunpro and marumori.
jlptsensei also glosses it as 'how'. どうしても is N3 in bunpro and marumori.
Tie between jlptsensei (N5) and marumori (N4); kept by the tie rule. Lexicalized question word + も; see interrogative-mo.

meaning: the most / the best / number one
notes: The full comparison frame is no-naka-de-ichiban.
何で can also be 'by what means' (なにで); same spelling, so the reading decides.
Tie between jlptsensei (N5) and marumori (こんな・そんな・あんな・どんな, N4); kept by the tie rule. bunpro and jlptsensei list そんな/そんなに at N4.
Only marumori lists counters as grammar. ひとり/ふたり are irregular readings.

meaning: general counter for things (one to nine)
notes: Only marumori lists it.
なぜなら〜から is N3 in marumori.
Conjunction.
Tie between marumori (N5) and bunpro (N4); kept by the tie rule.

meaning: polite prefix on nouns (お茶, ご飯)
notes: Only jlptsensei lists it at N5. Many words are lexicalized with it (ご飯, お腹); honorific お〜になる/お〜ください are N4 in jlptsensei and bunpro.
Only jlptsensei lists it.

meaning: quite / fairly; fine, no thank you
notes: Only bunpro lists it. Adverb use (quite) and na-adjective use (fine, no thanks) share the spelling.
Only marumori lists it.

meaning: good at, strong in / bad at, weak in
notes: Only marumori lists them. Related to no-ga-jouzu and no-ga-heta.
